proposition: Letter 16 belongs to the years around Shāhrukh's western Iranian campaign and the removal of Iskandar Mīrzā (816/1413-14), because Niʿmat Allāh's Shiraz visit of that date appears to have bracketed the campaign; MK does not date the letter itself.

mediation.note: MK's 'appears to have bracketed'; the date 816/1413-14 is for Niʿmat Allāh's visit (pdf p.244), not for the letter
